recognize_zh: 抹片中大量小到中型淋巴球，染色質呈塊狀、細胞質稀少，其中夾雜少數體積較大、細胞質較多且核染色質較疏鬆的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes），並有破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cell），符合 CLL 伴前淋巴球增加。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed clumped chromatin, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm
Admixed larger cells with moderately condensed chromatin and slightly more cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes
Occasional nuclear notching; nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells
Scattered platelet clumps; a granulated cell (likely basophil) and a segmented neutrophil at the bottom
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: The smear shows a marked predominance of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, admixed with a subset of larger cells with less condensed chromatin and more abundant cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes. Occasional nuclear notches are present, while a neutrophil and a granulated (likely basophil) cell represent residual myeloid elements. Platelet clumps are noted in the background. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes, supported by the CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative immunophenotype in this case.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells often have more irregular, cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative/FMC7-positive with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression, whereas CLL is CD23-positive and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: B-PLL shows >55% prolymphocytes with prominent central nucleoli and is typically CD5-weak/negative, CD23-negative and FMC7-bright, unlike this predominantly small-cell CD5+/CD23+ population.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and no smudge cells, and flow cytometry shows polytypic B cells without CD5 co-expression.
